recipes.steps: Soak the chunks in hot water for 10 min, squeeze out the water, fry in your pepper base, then simmer in the stew for 15 min.
Soak and squeeze the chunks, fry them with onions in the tomato base, then add rice and stock and cook as usual.
Soak and squeeze the chunks, coat in groundnut oil and suya spice (yaji), thread on skewers and grill or pan-fry for 8–10 min.

activities.title: Ask the village head first
activities.description: Meet the village head or ward leader before any tasting so the community knows who you are.

activities.title: Weekly market day stall
activities.description: Book one stall on the weekly market day and cook tuwo with soy-chunk miyan taushe for free tastes.
